title: SATA: The True/False Method
hook: SATA questions terrify nursing students. Here's the method that makes them easy.
scenario: Select all that apply: A patient with heart failure has decreased cardiac output. Which nursing interventions are appropriate? (A) Elevate HOB 30° (B) Administer digoxin (C) Restrict sodium intake (D) Encourage vigorous exercise (E) Monitor daily weights
answer: Treat EACH option as a true/false question. A=True (improves breathing). B=True (inotropic support). C=True (reduces fluid retention). D=False (contraindicated). E=True (monitors fluid status). Answer: A, B, C, E.
payoff: SATA Method: Read each option as a standalone true/false. Don't look for patterns. If it's true for the scenario, select it. No partial credit on NCLEX — all correct or nothing.
caption:
🚨 NCLEX Trap of the Day: SATA Questions

The method that makes SATA easy:

Treat EACH option as True/False.

Don't look for patterns.
Don't overthink.

If it's true → select it
If it's false → skip it

That's it. That's the secret.

Follow for tomorrow's trap 🎯
